Detailed Description

template<size_t b>
requires is_power_of_two_v<b>
struct Brick< b >

Pyramid structure for multi-resolution representation of a single brick.

Template Parameters
bBrick size (must be a power of two), total voxels = b^3

Represents a single spatial brick at multiple levels of detail (LOD). Level 0 is the finest resolution, level (Levels-1) is the coarsest.

void Brick< b >::build ( )

Build all pyramid levels from finest to coarsest.

Assumes level 0 (finest) is already initialized. Builds each coarser level using majority voting of child nodes.
